name: Historical Old Town Walking Tour through Abanotubani
description: You will wander through narrow, winding brick alleyways framed by ornate wooden balconies, unearthing the foundations of Tbilisi's ancient multi-faith coexistence. The walk takes you past 19th-century synagogues, mosques, and Armenian churches before opening up into the iconic dome-roofed sulfur district where the city was founded. You will cap off the loop by standing beneath the hidden Leghvtakhevi waterfall tucked right into the city center.

name: Traditional Kese Scrub and Mineral Soak at Chreli Abano
description: You will step inside a private, beautifully tiled underground chamber heated by natural hot springs rich in thermal therapeutic sulfur. After a deep 40-degree soak to loosen up your skin, a local bath attendant will give you a vigorous, traditional 'kese' body scrub using a rough woolen mitt, leaving you fully exfoliated. The experience wraps up with a cloud-like soapy foam wash and a cooling rinse under high-pressure mineral water.
duration_note: Advance booking highly recommended for private weekend evening slots; choose premium or royal rooms for better ventilation.

name: Traditional Soup Dumpling Feast at Pasanauri Restaurant
description: You will master the local culinary art of eating authentic Georgian khinkali—spiced, brothy meat dumplings wrapped in pleated dough. Your server will teach you to lift them by the thick dough handle, flip them upside down, bite a small vent hole, and slurp the boiling, aromatic broth inside without spilling a single drop. You'll pair these hand-twisted pockets with a cold, locally brewed lager or a tarragon-infused craft soda.
duration_note: Khinkali dough handles are traditionally left on the plate to keep count and are not meant to be eaten.

name: Natural Qvevri Wine Tasting Session at Vino Underground
description: You will descend into a historic stone cellar owned by local independent winemakers to explore amber and skin-contact wines made using the 8,000-year-old qvevri technique. An expert sommelier will guide your palate through unfiltered, wild-fermented varietals like Chinuri and Rkatsiteli, showcasing bold, tannic profiles rarely found in the West. Each glass is paired perfectly with regional dambalkhacho cheese, local walnuts, and freshly baked shoti sourdough bread.
duration_note: Features small-batch, low-intervention organic wines from family estates across eastern Georgia.

name: Underground Techno Dance Night at Club Bassiani
description: You will pass through industrial security checkpoints to dance inside an abandoned, drained Soviet-era swimming pool that now serves as one of the world's most revered electronic music institutions. You will experience absolute raw energy with a flawless, pounding sound system surrounded by local youth pushing boundaries in electronic subculture. The dark, smoke-filled main room and the house-oriented Horoom room run straight into Saturday afternoon.
duration_note: Strict door policy with a face control or online verification system; photos and videos are strictly forbidden inside with camera stickers applied at the door.

name: Courtyard Craft Beer and Socializing at Fabrika Urban Lounge
description: You will immerse yourself in Tbilisi's thriving creative community by spending an evening in the sprawling open-air courtyard of a former Soviet sewing factory converted into a multicultural hub. You will mingle with traveling artists, digital nomads, and local designers over glasses of Georgian amber beer, natural wines, and specialty cocktails. It is the premier launchpad for a night out, surrounded by street art murals, vintage boutique shops, and diverse ramen and burger bars.

name: Treasure Hunting and Antiquing at the Dry Bridge Flea Market
description: You will stroll through an expansive open-air bazaar sprawled across sidewalks and park lawns, exploring relics from Georgia's complex 20th-century history. You will bargain directly with eccentric local vendors selling everything from vintage Soviet cameras and enamel medals to hand-painted icons and mid-century vinyl records. It is a striking living museum where every tarnished silver trinket or military cap comes with a deeply personal family story attached.
duration_note: Market runs daily but is busiest on sunny weekends from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM; cash is mandatory and polite haggling is expected.

name: Architectural Pilgrimage to Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli
description: You will travel to Georgia's ancient ecclesiastical capital to stand inside monumental 6th and 11th-century cathedrals that secured the nation's early adoption of Christianity. You'll marvel at the pristine frescoes, stone carvings, and burial vaults inside Svetitskhoveli Cathedral before driving up to Jvari Monastery, an iconic hilltop stone church. From this panoramic precipice, you will gaze down at the dramatic, dual-colored confluence where the Aragvi and Mtkvari rivers meet.
duration_note: Strict dress codes apply for religious sites: women must cover their heads and wear long skirts, while men must wear pants; wraps are usually available at entrances.

name: Exploring the Ancient Caves of Uplistsikhe Rock-Hewn Town
description: You will hike across a wind-swept sandstone cliffside to explore an ancient pagan and Christian cave city that dates back to the Early Iron Age. You will scramble into hand-carved chambers, pagan temples of the sun goddess, ancient wine presses, and a functional 9th-century basilica carved directly into the living rock. The complex offers expansive views of the Mtkvari river basin and showcases remarkable pre-Christian rock-cut architecture.
duration_note: The rocky paths can be slippery and exposed; wear sturdy footwear with good grip and protect yourself from heavy sun exposure.

name: Walking the Ancient Stone Ramparts of Sighnaghi City Walls
description: You will stroll through cobble-stone avenues in an 18th-century royal town, ascending defensive brick guard towers built by King Heraclius II. From these high fortifications, you will look out over the immense, emerald Alazani Valley with the dramatic snow-dusted ridge lines of the Greater Caucasus rising in the distance. The pastel-colored houses with delicate gingerbread wood-carved balconies give the town an architectural atmosphere reminiscent of vintage romantic Europe.

name: Premium Estate Tour and Tasting at Chavchavadze Palace
description: You will explore the lush English-style botanical gardens and elegant 19th-century residential estate of Prince Alexander Chavchavadze, the pioneer who introduced classic European winemaking methods to Georgia. You'll descend into the historic brick cellars to see bottles of wine dating back to the 1840s before sitting down for an curated tasting session. You will taste the legendary, crisp Tsinandali dry white wine alongside traditional Kakhetian amber varietals.
duration_note: The museum and wine cellars are open year-round; ticket prices vary depending on the number of premium wines selected for the flight.

name: Hyper-Local Supra Feast and Culinary Masterclass at Shumi Winery
description: You will roll up your sleeves next to a Kakhetian home cook to mold spiced ground meat onto metal skewers for authentic mtsvadi pork barbecue grilled over dried grapevines. You will string walnuts together and dip them into boiling, thick grape juice flour reductions to harvest your own sweet churchkhela candies from scratch. The afternoon peaks with an open-air supra banquet hosted by a dedicated tamada (toastmaster), featuring continuous pours of strong qvevri wine.
duration_note: Requires booking 48 hours in advance; transport should be pre-arranged as Georgia enforces strict zero-tolerance laws for any drinking and driving.

name: Exploring the Subterranean Wine Tunnels of Khareba
description: You will head deep inside the rolling foothills of the Caucasus Mountains by entering a massive underground complex of converted military tunnels spanning 7.7 kilometers. You will walk through cool, rock-cut shafts where over 26,000 bottles of premium Georgian wine are aged at a constant, natural temperature of 14 degrees Celsius. Your guided tour concludes in a polished mountain-view tasting room with deep sips of award-winning, oak-aged Saperavi red wines.
duration_note: The tunnels maintain a chilly temperature year-round; bring a light jacket or sweater even when visiting during the hot peak summer months.

name: Hiking the Sub-Tropical Trails to Ninoskhevi Waterfall
description: You will hike along the edge of the wild Lagodekhi Protected Areas, crossing pristine glacial rivers and trekking through ancient, deep-green hornbeam forests. Your trail involves balancing across moss-covered boulders and navigating rocky river beds deep inside a rugged mountain canyon. The challenging trek pays off when you reach the stunning Ninoskhevi Waterfall, which cascades down a 40-meter vertical shale cliff into an icy swimming pool.
duration_note: Requires good physical fitness and waterproof trekking shoes; river water levels can swell rapidly after heavy rainfall events.

name: Trekking the Monastic Desert Cliffs of David Gareja Lavra
description: You will traverse an otherworldly, semi-desert landscape along the disputed border with Azerbaijan to find a sprawling 6th-century cave monastery complex. You will hike up steep, wind-scoured ridges to peer into cellars, ancient refectories, and remote chapels dug out of vibrant, rainbow-striped clay hills. The silence of the desert combined with the ancient, weathered religious architecture makes this one of Georgia's most evocative wilderness journeys.
duration_note: Parts of the higher ridge trail can close due to sensitive border demarcation; check local updates and watch out for vipers in hot weather.

name: Late-Night Wine Flights and Vinyl at Pheasant's Tears Bar
description: You will spend your evening unwinding in a dimly lit, historic brick tavern listening to a collection of vintage Georgian folk vinyl records. You will talk with eccentric winemakers while sampling artisanal, unfiltered natural wines poured directly from specialized earthenware jars. The cozy, candlelit tables foster intimate conversations, making it the perfect sanctuary for late-night wine exploration deep within the historic fortress town.
duration_note: The venue serves excellent seasonal farm-to-table plates alongside rare, small-batch experimental vintage bottles.

name: Alpine Mountain Hike to Gergeti Trinity Church
description: You will trek along a steep, pine-scented alpine singletrack trail rising directly out of Stepantsminda village, aiming for a dramatic mountain ridge line. You will emerge at a breathtaking 2,170 meters elevation to stand at the base of the iconic 14th-century stone church. If the weather is clear, you will be rewarded with majestic views of the colossal, jagged peak of Mount Kazbek towering behind the church profile at 5,054 meters.
duration_note: You can opt for a steep 1.5-hour hike or hire a local 4WD vehicle; dress in warm layers as mountain weather changes rapidly.

name: Chasing Waterfalls in the Narrow Gveleti Gorge
description: You will travel through the forbidding, vertical rock faces of the Dariali Gorge before setting out on a short, rocky foot trek into a hidden canyon. You will navigate a rugged path surrounded by towering basalt cliffs to reach two secluded alpine waterfalls that plunge violently into icy rock basins. The misty air is highly refreshing, and the sheer scale of the surrounding mountain cliffs showcases the raw geological power of the high Caucasus.
duration_note: The final 500 meters of the trail require walking over unstable scree and loose rocks; high-grip footwear is highly recommended.

name: Exploring the Lakeside Towers of Ananuri Fortress Complex
description: You will make a classic stop along the historic Georgian Military Highway to explore a dramatic, stone-walled castle complex that once belonged to the feudal Dukes of Aragvi. You will climb up narrow, dark internal stone ladders to reach the topmost arrow slits of the 17th-century defense tower. From this vantage point, you will look out across the brilliant, turquoise waters of the massive Zhinvali Reservoir framed by dense green forest mountains.
duration_note: A highly convenient stop-off during transit from Tbilisi to Stepantsminda; can get crowded with tour buses at mid-day.

name: Mountain-View Terrace Dining at Rooms Hotel Restaurant
description: You will pull up a seat on a wide, stylish wooden outdoor sun deck to indulge in refined regional mountain cuisine while taking in one of the most famous hotel views in Eurasia. You will treat yourself to rich Kazbegi-style lamb stew, wild mushroom tarts, and local craft beers while staring directly at the sheer vertical rock wall of Mount Kazbek. The interior features industrial-chic design aesthetics mixed with cozy plush leather sofas and floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass windows.
duration_note: Peak dinner hours fill up completely; book outside guests tables in advance or arrive mid-afternoon for lunch to secure outside deck seating.

name: Après-Ski Craft Cocktails at Powder Bar Gudauri
description: You will step out of the alpine cold and into a modern, energetic mountainside lounge tailored specifically for freeriders and mountain adventurers. You will warm up with house-infused chacha shots, warm spiced mulled wine, and artisanal cocktails while a live DJ spins upbeat lounge and deep house electronic sets. The bar boasts panoramic mountain views, providing an incredible venue to swap winter trail stories with international winter athletes.
duration_note: Operates fully during the winter skiing season (December to April) with reduced weekend-only operating hours in late summer.

name: Tandem Paragliding Flights Over the Jvari Pass Canyons
description: You will strap into a high-performance harness with a professional tandem pilot, running off a cliff side at the Russia-Georgia Friendship Monument to catch powerful alpine thermal currents. You will soar like an eagle hundreds of meters above the jagged Aragvi Gorge, looking down on steep volcanic canyons and tiny high-mountain settlements. The sheer rush of adrenaline is matched by the jaw-dropping, 360-degree views of the monumental peaks of the Greater Caucasus.
duration_note: Strictly subject to local daily wind and thermal conditions; use only fully certified pilots with reserve parachutes.

name: Off-Road Wilderness Trekking through Truso Gorge
description: You will journey down a rugged, unpaved track into an otherworldly valley shaped by deep volcanic activity and mineral springs. You will explore abandoned stone villages, crumbling defensive towers, and surreal, bubbling orange travertine formations caused by mineral-rich lime springs. The dramatic wilderness trail runs along the rushing Terek River, offering an incredible landscape devoid of modern commercial development.
duration_note: Requires a high-clearance 4WD vehicle; the far end of the valley approaches the South Ossetian border zone where military check-posts require carrying passports.

name: Cycling the Subtropical Seafront Promenades of Batumi Boulevard
description: You will rent a bright green public smart-bike to coast along a beautifully manicured, 7-kilometer seaside path bordered by towering palm trees and modern architectural icons. You will ride past kinetic art structures like the moving Ali and Nino statue, unique alphabet towers, and lively beach clubs. The sea breeze and the vibrant energy of the coast make it the absolute best way to experience Batumi's coastal revival.
location: Miracle Park to New Boulevard, Batumi
duration_note: Boulevard can get highly crowded with pedestrians during sunset hours; use designated red bicycle lanes.

name: Decadent Adjarian Khachapuri Baking Class at Retro
description: You will master the heavy art of building Georgia's legendary boat-shaped cheese bread under the tutelage of expert local bakers. You will learn to knead the soft yeasted dough, form the high side crusts, and fill the hull with massive amounts of salty Adjarian sulguni cheese before sliding it into a roaring oven. Once baked, you'll slide a raw egg yolk and a heavy pat of butter into the molten core, stirring it vigorously at your table to form a decadent dip.
duration_note: An intensely filling meal; eat it traditional style by tearing off pieces of the outer crust to dip into the molten cheese core.

name: Exploring Cape Verde at the Batumi Botanical Garden
description: You will walk across steep, coastal cliff sides that drop straight down into the waves of the Black Sea, exploring a massive sanctuary of global flora. You will wander through distinct microclimates ranging from Himalayan bamboo forests to Australian eucalyptus groves, all thriving under Batumi's distinct subtropical climate. The high cliff overlooks offer sweeping, panoramic views of the curving city skyline and the deep blue sea expanse.
duration_note: The park covers extensive steep hilly terrain; electric golf carts are available for hire near the main entrance gates if walking becomes too strenuous.

name: Stepping back to Antiquity at Gonio-Apsaros Fortress
description: You will wander inside the stone battlements of Georgia's oldest Roman-Byzantine coastal fortification, located just a few kilometers from the Turkish border. You will trace ancient clay water pipes, see old Roman bath foundations, and walk beneath high stone watchtowers that once guarded strategic trade paths. The interior of the fort is filled with lush Kiwi plantations and orange groves, giving it an intriguing, overgrown historical atmosphere.
duration_note: A highly convenient day-trip addition when combined with swimming at the nearby clean pebble beaches of Sarpi.

name: Sky-High Craft Cocktails at Sector 26 Roof Lounge
description: You will take a sleek elevator up above the seafront to dance on a glamorous, open-air rooftop beach club that overlooks the Black Sea. You will sip premium cocktails, unwind in luxury cabanas, and listen to touring international deep house DJs as night settles over the coast. The club features a stunning infinity pool reflecting neon lights, capturing the trendy, high-energy party atmosphere that defines Batumi's peak summer season.
duration_note: Operates fully during peak summer months (June to September); premium entry fees apply on nights with major international headliners.

name: White-Water Kayaking and Rafting on the Adjaristskali River
description: You will gear up with professional instructors to paddle through technical Class II and III rapids inside a deep, emerald-green mountain valley. You will battle churning river bends and navigate rocky chutes before floating down into calmer river pools. After your run, you will stop to see the neighboring 12th-century stone arch bridge of King Tamar, an architectural marvel built using local volcanic stones.
duration_note: Optimal white-water currents occur from April to June during mountain snowmelt; helmets and life vests are mandatory.

name: Sunset Sailing Cruise along Batumi Bay
description: You will board a sleek, modern sailing yacht from the Batumi Marina to head out into the deep waters of the Black Sea as the sun touches the horizon. You will gaze back to see the ultra-modern skyline of Batumi light up in neon shades, contrasted against the massive dark silhouettes of the Caucasus Mountains. Keep your eyes fixed on the water, as pods of wild Bottlenose dolphins frequently surface right alongside the boat's hull.
duration_note: Shared boat excursions run hourly, but private boat rentals should be booked a day in advance during high summer.

name: Fresh Seafood Selection and Feast at Batumi Fish Market
description: You will explore a lively, authentic local seafood market to select raw Black Sea turbot, red mullet, or fresh mussels directly from the morning catch. After paying the fishmonger, you will walk next door to one of the traditional seaside taverns where chefs will immediately clean, season, and pan-fry your selection. You will enjoy your perfectly crisped seafood feast on an outdoor terrace, paired with a chilled glass of dry Adjarian Tsolikouri white wine.
duration_note: Arrive around 1:00 PM when the morning fishing boats have completely unloaded their freshest catches.

name: Trekking the High Mountain Pass to the Koruldi Lakes
description: You will set out on a challenging alpine trek rising steeply out of Mestia, climbing through rich pine forests to reach high ridge pastures at 2,740 meters. You will arrive at a series of pristine alpine tarns that act as mirrors, reflecting the jaw-dropping walls of Mount Ushba and Mount Shkhara. The mountain vistas look down into steep glacial valleys, offering an unbelievable sense of isolation high inside the raw wilderness.
duration_note: A highly strenuous trek with over 1,300 meters of vertical elevation gain; can be bypassed by hiring a professional local 4WD driver.

name: Exploring Europe's Highest Inhabited Village and Svan Towers
description: You will travel along a rugged mountain track to enter a community of high-altitude villages sitting beneath the massive icy wall of Mount Shkhara. You will walk amidst over 200 ancient, stone Svan defense towers built between the 9th and 12th centuries to protect families from blood feuds and avalanches. You will step inside a preserved stone home-fortress to discover how medieval mountain communities lived through harsh, isolated winter lock-ins.
duration_note: The dirt road from Mestia to Ushguli requires a high-clearance 4WD vehicle and can be closed by mudslides or snow outside of June-October.

name: Glacial Trekking to the Base of Chalaadi Glacier
description: You will walk across a swaying suspension bridge over the roaring Mestiachala River to hike a trail through wild, boulder-strewn valleys. You will trek through ancient forests before emerging into a dramatic canyon where the massive wall of ice begins. You will stand near the mouth of the Chalaadi Glacier, watching columns of freezing water burst out from under the ice sheets beneath the towering spires of Mount Ushba.
duration_note: Stay clear of the immediate ice face mouth, as rockfalls caused by melting ice occur frequently and pose a safety risk.

name: Tasting Kubdari and Svanetian Salt Kitchen Masterclass
description: You will gather inside a rustic mountain kitchen to learn the traditional method of baking authentic Kubdari—the celebratory meat pie of Svaneti. You will season hand-chopped beef or pork with wild, high-altitude blue fenugreek, coriander, and garlic gathered from the alpine slopes. You'll also learn the secret ratios of Svanetian salt, grinding mountain herbs with coarse sea salt to take home a jar of Georgia's most famous seasoning blend.
duration_note: Unlike typical Georgian pastries, authentic Kubdari uses hand-chopped knife-cut meat rather than ground meat.

name: Svaneti Museum of History and Ethnography Tour
description: You will step into a striking, modern museum complex to view an incredible collection of treasures that were hidden away in this mountain fortress region during lowland invasions. You will marvel at 10th-century illuminated gospels, gold-plated icons, and ancient armor crafted by master Svan blacksmiths. The exhibition offers deep, clear insights into how this isolated mountain culture preserved its unique pre-Christian beliefs and linguistic identity.
duration_note: Closed on Mondays; english-language audio guides or local museum guides are available at the reception desk.

name: Live Polyphonic Folk Songs at Buba Bar
description: You will pull up a wooden bench in a cozy, timber-walled mountain tavern to enjoy an evening of haunting Svan polyphonic folk music played by local artists. You will listen to intricate, complex multi-part harmonies accompanied by traditional stringed instruments like the chuniri and changi. The bar fills with locals and trekkers sharing stories, fueled by continuous rounds of local chacha grape brandy and hearty mountain pub food.
duration_note: Live acoustic performances typically begin late, around 9:00 PM; seating is limited so arrive early during the peak trekking season.

name: The Epic 4-Day Svaneti Wilderness Trek
description: You will embark on Georgia's most famous multi-day wilderness journey, hiking from village to remote village across wild rivers and high alpine passes. You will hike beneath massive mountain glaciers, overnighting with local family guesthouses in tiny, tower-filled settlements like Adishi and Iprali. The route challenges your endurance but rewards you with an authentic connection to mountain hospitality and untouched Caucasus landscapes.
duration_note: The route requires high physical fitness; operational season is strictly limited from mid-June to early October due to high pass snowpack.

name: Exploring UNESCO Architecture at Gelati Monastery
description: You will travel into the forested hills outside Kutaisi to explore a majestic 12th-century monastic complex that served as Georgia's grand center of science and philosophy. You will stand beneath towering church vaults completely covered in pristine, brilliant Byzantine-style mosaic art and deep blue medieval murals. You will also walk over the humble stone tomb of King David the Builder, Georgia's most celebrated historic ruler.
duration_note: Active restoration work may restrict entry to certain interior nave wings; conservative church dress codes apply.

name: Inflatable Boat Paddling through Martvili Canyon
description: You will board an inflatable river raft to paddle through a breathtaking, moss-draped limestone canyon filled with brilliant emerald waters. You will navigate between narrow, vertical stone walls where natural waterfalls cascade directly into the river from the high cliffs above. After the short river paddle, you will follow a network of scenic wooden boardwalks and stone bridges to view dramatic rock pools and old mill structures.
duration_note: Boat tours do not operate during or immediately after heavy rains due to dangerous river swelling; life jackets are provided.

name: Riding the Soviet Cable Cars of Chiatura Mining Town
description: You will travel into a steep, rugged river canyon to explore an industrial manganese mining town famous for its historic transport network. You will step into freshly renovated aerial cable cars that replace the iconic 1950s 'Stalin's ropeways,' lifting you up sheer vertical cliffs to high residential ridges. The journey offers a fascinating glimpse into industrial Soviet planning and provides dramatic, industrial views over the canyon landscape below.
duration_note: Best visited as an architectural day-trip destination from Kutaisi; the cars operate on a daily public transit schedule.

name: Urban Exploration of Abandoned Soviet Sanatoriums
description: You will wander through grand, overgrown neoclassical spa resorts that once hosted thousands of workers during the peak of the Soviet Union's state-sponsored wellness programs. You will photograph crumbling grand ballrooms, decaying mosaic fountains, and massive columned entrance halls slowly being reclaimed by wild ivy and trees. It is an incredible, haunting destination for history buffs, photographers, and fans of unique Soviet monumental architecture.
duration_note: Many structures are abandoned and unmaintained; watch your step around loose masonry, crumbling floors, and exposed drop-offs.

name: Savoring Imeretian Khachapuri at Sisters Restaurant
description: You will experience authentic regional dining inside a beautifully restored 19th-century apartment filled with vintage lace curtains and a live piano. You will dine on authentic Imeretian khachapuri, a flat cheese bread stuffed with mild, tangy local curd cheese cooked inside a clay skillet. You will pair this with pkhali—vibrant spreads made from minced walnuts, spinach, beetroot, and wild pomegranate seeds.
duration_note: The restaurant is highly popular for its preservation of rare, authentic western Georgian family recipes.

name: Subterranean Exploration of Prometheus Cave
description: You will walk along a 1.4-kilometer underground path through six massive karst chambers filled with spectacular displays of stalactites and stalagmites. You will marvel at unique rock formations beautifully illuminated by atmospheric LED light installations while soft classical music echoes through the caverns. The underground journey peaks with an unforgettable boat ride along a mysterious subterranean river that exits into the outer canyon.
duration_note: Closed on Mondays; the optional underground boat ride is fully dependent on daily subterranean river water levels.

name: Local Craft Beer and Vinyl Sessions at Barber's Pub
description: You will dive straight into Kutaisi's cozy, alternative nightlife scene by visiting a quirky pub filled with vintage record players and eccentric local art. You will socialize with friendly local students and artists while sampling excellent craft beers brewed right in western Georgia. The laid-back, community-driven vibe makes it the absolute best venue to unwind after an active day exploring the surrounding regional canyons.

name: Thermal Mineral Bath Soak at Spring No. 6
description: You will step inside a grand, functional Soviet-era bathhouse to bathe in famous 'radon-carbonated' thermal waters that flow naturally at a perfect 35 degrees Celsius. You will relax inside a private marble pool where mineral-rich water continuously flushes through, soothing joint paint and relieving skin inflammation. The experience can be paired with a classic therapeutic massage inside private treatment rooms designed for high-ranking historic figures.
duration_note: Advance booking is required for premium private mineral pools and therapeutic massage sessions.
